|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | FY2024 Q4 + FY | "fiscal 2024 fourth quarter and full year ended May 31, 2024" | 2024-06-27 | [REC-NKE-01-01]–[REC-NKE-01-05] |

| O3 | FY2025 Q4 + FY (final locked) | "fiscal 2025 fourth quarter and full year ended May 31, 2025" | 2025-06-26 | [REC-NKE-03-01]–[REC-NKE-03-03] |

Sequence is monotonic and period labels are unchanged. All three are NKE 8-K earnings releases with unaudited consolidated income statements; currency-neutral measures are non-GAAP per the filings' own asterisk notes.

Direction of travel (reported basis, as filed): total revenue moved from roughly flat at O1 ("down 2 percent" Q4; FY "up 1 percent on a currency-neutral basis") to "down 8 percent" at O2, to "down 12 percent" Q4 / "down 10 percent" FY at O3. NIKE Brand went from "down 1 percent" (O1 Q4) to "down 7 percent" (O2) to "down 11 percent" (O3). Converse went from "down 18 percent" to "down 17 percent" to "down 26 percent." NIKE Brand Digital declines accelerated monotonically: 10% → 21% → 26%. Wholesale went from "up 5 percent" to "down 3 percent" to "down 9 percent." NIKE-owned stores were the sole improving channel at O3 ("a 2 percent increase"). Gross margin: 44.7% (O1 Q4) → 43.6% (O2) → 40.3% (O3 Q4).

## Evidence Reconciliation

**Verified source facts (quoted verbatim):**
- NKE-Q2FY25-REV: "Revenues $ 12,354" (three months ended 11/30/2024) [REC-NKE-02-01]
- NKE-Q4FY25-REV: "Revenues $ 11,097" (three months ended 5/31/2025) [REC-NKE-03-01]

The fiscal periods do not: Q2 (ended 11/30/2024) versus Q4 (ended 5/31/2025) are non-adjacent quarters. The comparison is cross-quarter, not sequential or year-over-year. All figures are unaudited press-release statements; no audited 10-K figures are in evidence.

**Conflicts and exclusions:** Reported versus currency-neutral figures diverge (FY2025 "down 10 percent" reported vs "down 9 percent" currency-neutral [REC-NKE-03-02]); no currency-neutral dollar levels are disclosed, so no currency-neutral calculation is reproduced. Segment/channel detail is Q4-only at O1 and O3 but Q2-only at O2, so cross-observation channel comparisons are quarter-mismatched. Several records are truncated mid-sentence (e.g., [REC-NKE-03-01] ends at "Effec"); nothing was inferred from truncation. AMD records [REC-AMD-01-01]–[REC-AMD-01-03] and NVIDIA records [REC-NVDA-01-01]–[REC-NVDA-03-03] are unrelated issuers and were excluded from all NKE conclusions.

## Calculation Audit

Derived calculations (policy-specified, source-cited, rounded as required):

1. **FSEC-NKE-03 comparison 1 — percent_change, NKE-Q2FY25-REV → NKE-Q4FY25-REV: −10.2%** (from $12,354M to $11,097M) [REC-NKE-02-01, REC-NKE-03-01]

Both calculations are justified by cited records and independently reproduced by all three specialists. No other derived metrics are reported. These are not seasonally adjusted and should not be read as a clean sequential trend.

## Risk and Governance

**Downside evidence at the final observation:** revenue decline deepened to "down 12 percent" for Q4 and "down 10 percent" for FY [REC-NKE-03-01, REC-NKE-03-02]; gross margin fell to 40.3%, "decreased 440 basis points" [REC-NKE-03-02]; "Income before income taxes 318 1,726 -82 %" for the quarter and "-42 %" for the year [REC-NKE-03-01]; "Diluted earnings per share was $0.14 for the fourth quarter" [REC-NKE-03-02]; Digital −26% and Converse −26% [REC-NKE-03-03]; "Demand creation expense was $1.3 billion, up 15 percent" while revenue fell [REC-NKE-03-03].

## Limitations

- Only three NKE observations are in evidence; no Q1/Q3 FY2025 or FY2023 detail is available, so the trend is sampled, not continuous.
- The two required calculations compare non-adjacent quarters (Q2 vs Q4), so they are not a like-for-like sequential or year-over-year measure; seasonality and mix effects are not quantified in the records.
- All NKE figures are unaudited earnings-release statements; no audited 10-K data is present.
- Currency-neutral (non-GAAP) measures lack disclosed dollar reconciliations in the provided excerpts.
- Segment and channel detail is quarter-mismatched across observations, and no standalone Digital or owned-stores dollar figures are given.
- Multiple records are truncated mid-sentence; no values were inferred from truncated text.
- The evidence pool contains AMD and NVIDIA records that are irrelevant to this question; their presence is a retrieval-quality concern, and they were excluded.
